description: Rb₃NaTiO₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are three inequivalent Rb sites. In the first Rb site, Rb is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Rb-O bond distances ranging from 2.88-3.00 Å. In the second Rb site, Rb is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Rb-O bond distances ranging from 2.84-3.38 Å. In the third Rb site, Rb is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Rb-O bond distances ranging from 2.81-3.14 Å. Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent TiO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.45 Å. Ti is bonded to four O atoms to form TiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.84 Å) and two longer (1.86 Å) Ti-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Rb, one Na, and one Ti atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to five Rb and one Ti atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Rb, two equivalent Na, and one Ti atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to four Rb, one Na, and one Ti atom.
